otc_recommendations: Acetaminophen (Tylenol) or Ibuprofen (Advil/Motrin) for aches and fever
Decongestants like Pseudoephedrine (Sudafed) for nasal stuffiness (consult pharmacist)
Cough suppressants with Dextromethorphan for dry cough
Saline nasal drops or spray
self_care: Drink plenty of fluids, rest, use a humidifier, and gargle with salt water.

otc_recommendations: Acetaminophen or Ibuprofen for fever and body aches
Stay hydrated with water, broth, or electrolyte drinks
Avoid aspirin in children (risk of Reye's syndrome)
self_care: Strict bed rest, isolation to prevent spread, and high fluid intake.
red_flags: Difficulty breathing or shortness of breath

otc_recommendations: Acetaminophen or Ibuprofen for fever and pain relief
Cough medicine to soothe throat and lungs
Hydration and rest
self_care: Isolate from others, monitor oxygen levels if possible, and rest.
red_flags: Persistent pain or pressure in the chest
Inability to wake or stay awake

symptoms: red spots on roof of mouth
otc_recommendations: Acetaminophen or Ibuprofen for pain and fever
Salt water gargle (1/4 tsp salt in 8oz warm water)
Throat lozenges or anesthetic sprays
self_care: Eat soft foods, drink cold liquids, and rest your voice.
red_flags: Inability to swallow or excessive drooling

otc_recommendations: Phenazopyridine (AZO) for temporary relief of urinary pain and burning
Increase water intake significantly to flush bacteria
self_care: Avoid caffeine, alcohol, and spicy foods which can irritate the bladder.

otc_recommendations: Acetaminophen or Ibuprofen for pain relief
Warm compress against the affected ear
self_care: Keep the ear dry and rest.
red_flags: Severe pain that suddenly stops (may indicate ruptured eardrum)

otc_recommendations: Physical and cognitive rest are primary
Acetaminophen for headache (avoid Ibuprofen/Aspirin initially due to bleeding risk)
self_care: Avoid screens (phones/TV), limit mental exertion, and sleep.

otc_recommendations: Oral Rehydration Salts (Pedialyte/Gatorade)
Bismuth subsalicylate (Pepto-Bismol) for nausea/diarrhea
Loperamide (Imodium) ONLY if no fever or bloody stools
self_care: Sip small amounts of clear liquids, avoid solid food until vomiting stops.

otc_recommendations: No OTC substitute for rescue inhalers
Follow your prescribed Asthma Action Plan
self_care: Sit upright, stay calm, and move away from triggers.
source: Asthma and Allergy Foundation of America

otc_recommendations: Antihistamines (Diphenhydramine/Claritin/Zyrtec)
Hydrocortisone cream for skin rashes
self_care: Identify and remove the allergen source, use cool compresses.
red_flags: Swelling of lips, tongue, or throat
